children: RBC Capital Markets on Tuesday upgraded ResMed
to Outperform from Sector Perform and raised its price target to $262 from $244, citing positives in the respiratory device maker’s Q4 results for fiscal 2026.

fell in early August as investors reacted to its Q4 FY26 report, which, according to RBC analyst Craig Wong-Pan, included a large share buyback program for FY27 and was the first time the company issued revenue
Wong-Pan expects the San Diego, California-based MedTech to record high-single-digit earnings per share growth over the next three years despite a potential U.S. return of the rival Philips
, which faced a recall of millions of respiratory devices in 2021.
The earnings report, which was also the first for ResMed’s

new CFO, Aaron Bloomer, “marked a pivotal change in how the company will be fiscally managed,” wrote the analyst, adding that his upgrade was based on the company’s “positive earnings outlook and an undemanding valuation.”

title: ResMed upgraded at RBC Capital Markets on Q4 positives
